title: 第11章 一家人团聚第12章 屈服
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
听到来人声音。
叶不凡猛然抬头，身体不由自主地微微颤抖，指着对方怒吼道：
“姜…姓姜的！
你这个…”
砰！
姜夜直接一棍子打断施法，狠狠敲在他脑门上。
叶不凡整个人被打得倒飞出去，脑袋上瞬间鼓起一个大包，狼狈至极。
“好好说话！”
姜夜笑吟吟地提醒着，语气温和却带着莫名的压迫感，走到叶不凡面前补充道：“不感谢我吗？我可是准备了这么大排场的见面礼，好让你一家团聚，整整齐齐的一起上路。”
叶不凡鼻血横流，艰难地撑起身子，眼中满是怨毒与愤恨。
“你…你到底要…”
砰！
砰！
砰！
姜夜挥舞着棒球棍，一棍接一棍地招呼在叶不凡身上，每一下都避开要害，却疼得他几欲昏厥。
“快感谢我！”
叶不凡感觉自己全身都被打骨折了，身上传来的疼痛感过于剧烈，一时间分不清谁是谁了，竟然眼泪汪汪地哭出声来。
一旁的叶父跪倒在地，眼中满是绝望，对着姜夜哀求道：“神子殿下，求您别打了，不知犬子究竟是何缘故得罪了您……”
“老东西，我让你说话了吗？”
砰！

砰！
砰！
姜夜话音未落，棒棍已至。
转瞬之间，叶父也被敲得满头是血，狼狈不堪。
残暴！
太残暴了！
众人依旧跪伏在地，大气不敢出。
没有人敢说什么，内心煎熬着，只希望这场闹剧快点结束。
再也不凑热闹了。
姜夜又再度转头看向叶不凡，高高举起棒球棍，笑嘻嘻地道：“还不快感谢我？”
叶不凡被打得浑身抽搐，脸色一阵红一阵白，嘴唇颤抖。
他惨笑着道：“你…要杀便杀！
但休想…”
砰！
砰砰！
又是一顿棍棒教育。
“我…我我错了，谢谢你……”
content_en:
Hear someone's voice.
Ye Bufan suddenly raised his head, his body trembling slightly involuntarily, pointing at the other party and roaring:
"Jiang...the one with the surname Jiang!
You..."
Bang!
Jiang Ye interrupted the spell with a stick and hit him hard on the head.
Ye Bufan was knocked upside down and a big bump suddenly bulged on his head, making him extremely embarrassed.
"Speak nicely!"
Jiang Ye reminded with a smile, his tone was gentle but with an inexplicable sense of oppression. He walked up to Ye Bufan and added, "Don't you want to thank me? I have prepared such a grand meeting gift so that your family can reunite and go on the road together."
Ye Bufan had a nosebleed and struggled to stand up, his eyes full of resentment and resentment.
"You...what do you want..."
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Jiang Ye waved his baseball bat and hit Ye Bufan one after another. Each blow avoided his vital points, but the pain made him almost faint.
"Thank me quickly!"
Ye Bufan felt like his whole body had been broken and broken. The pain coming from his body was so severe that he couldn't tell who was who for a while, and he cried out with tears in his eyes.
Father Ye fell to his knees on the ground, his eyes full of despair, and begged Jiang Ye: "Your Highness, Son of God, please stop fighting. I don't know why Quanzi offended you..."
"Old man, did I let you speak?"
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Before Jiang Ye finished speaking, the stick had arrived.
In the blink of an eye, Ye's father was also beaten until his head was covered with blood and he was in a miserable state.
brutal!
How cruel!
Everyone was still kneeling on the ground, not daring to express their anger.
No one dared to say anything. They were suffering in their hearts and just hoped that this farce would end soon.
No more joining in the fun.
Jiang Ye turned to look at Ye Bufan again, raised his baseball bat high, and said with a smile, "Why don't you thank me quickly?"
Ye Bufan was beaten until his whole body twitched, his face turned red and white, and his lips trembled.
He smiled miserably and said: "You... kill me if you want!
But don’t even think about it…”
Bang!
Bang bang!
Another lesson with a stick.
"I...I, I was wrong, thank you..."
